text:
linda_partner: Quick heads-up — Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant want a coordinated marketplace + hardware demo announcement. We need an embargoed dry-run and a clear owner for the on-prem appliance demo.

ravi_eng: I can own the demo infra if we freeze the OS/container image by next Tues. What hardware partner SKU are we showcasing?

ashley_sales: HW partner is "AuroraEdge" (per legal). They need the SW image by 2026-04-06 for QA.

maria_pm: Timeline ask from PM/marketing: go/no-go for joint announcement is 2026-04-15. Can we commit?

ben_infra: For the appliance demo we need a staging subnet in our EU VPC and a limited NAT rule set. I'll spin up a sandbox cluster but need IP allowlist from AuroraEdge and Snow.

linda_partner: @ben_infra noted. AuroraEdge team already sent an initial CIDR but it's missing the CI runners. @ashley_sales can you get their CI IPs?

ashley_sales: pinged AuroraEdge on Slack — they replied in DM with the runner IPs, will paste here when they confirm rotation policy.

si_team_lead: SI integration checklist: auth (SAML), secrets (KMS), and sample ETL pipeline to Databricks. Who owns SAML cert exchange?

ravi_eng: I can handle SAML setup and KMS mapping. SI team: we’ll need a sample notebook and a small ingest job (10k rows) to demo latency.

press_ops: Press/marketing note: embargo window needs 48h lead and legal sign-off on partner quotes. We also need a customer reference approval if we show a case study.

maria_pm: Add to checklist — customer reference approval. If we can't get it, we'll use a synthetic demo dataset.

linda_partner: Draft runbook snippet for dry-run (putting here so it's visible):
```
- T-7 days: freeze docs & demo scripts. owners: @maria_pm, @ravi_eng
- T-5 days: hardware image delivered to Redwood staging. owner: AuroraEdge / @ben_infra to validate
- T-3 days: SI dry-run (SAML + ingest). owner: @si_team_lead
- T-1 day: press embargo email drafted & legal review. owner: @press_ops
- Day 0: live announcement + marketplace listing + hw demo stream
```

ravi_eng: Also adding a small fallback plan: if AuroraEdge appliance isn't ready, we fall back to cloud-only demo with dedicated capacity and the same workload. That keeps the announcement intact.

ben_infra: I'll add firewall + NAT config to infra repo. Quick snippet:
```bash
# example allowlist entry
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-xxxx --protocol tcp --port 22 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24
```

ashley_sales: AuroraEdge asked about co-branding on the marketplace tile — legal needs to approve logos. @press_ops can you loop in legal?

press_ops: On it. Will create an internal thread with legal and share required assets list by EOD.

si_team_lead: Quick question re: telemetry — do we show telemetry to partners during demo or mask tokens? We must not expose customer tokens.

ravi_eng: Mask everything. We'll use synthetic prompts and redact any real tokens. Telemetry will be aggregated latency/cost numbers only.

maria_pm: Who's owning the marketplace listing metadata (short desc, screenshots, pricing notes)? Need that done by T-4.

linda_partner: @maria_pm + @ashley_sales own listing metadata. @maria_pm will draft; @ashley_sales will confirm partner-facing messaging.

ashley_sales: Ack. I'll coordinate with AuroraEdge marketing for a quote and logos.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/demo-cluster to start 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC (rolling).

linda_partner: Ok team, action items summarized:
- @ravi_eng: SAML + demo scripts (due T-3)
- @ben_infra: infra + firewall entries (due T-5)
- @maria_pm: marketplace metadata & docs freeze (due T-4)
- @ashley_sales: partner assets + CI IPs (due T-6)
- @si_team_lead: SI dry-run coordination (due T-3)
- @press_ops: embargo email + legal (due T-1)

ashley_sales: I'll post the AuroraEdge runner IPs here when they confirm. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: Starting infra tickets now. I'll link to https://redwood.company/internal/infra/tickets/314 in a bit.

linda_partner: Thanks all — let's do a dry-run next Thursday and sync 30m after to capture learnings. :rocket:
